quote.translation: The constitutive content of a concept, insofar as it signifies a universal determination, has the value of a law for the individual representations to be subsumed under that concept, and consequently any possible content that runs counter to the constitutive content is seen as a possible exception.

quote.translation: We also have, say, the concept of clover.

quote.translation: Three leaves are found in clover "for the most part", or "almost always", and so we witness this as an identity and make it, as an essential mark, part of the constitutive content of the concept of clover.

quote.translation: Strictly speaking it cannot be called a necessary mark, but insofar as it is grasped as an identity we regard it as "quasi-necessary", and it thereby acquires the value of a law.
